h1.en: Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump: 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm beside the Loader (equipment) article
h1.zh: 为什么拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的外形尺寸不是泵送距离：对照「装载机」时，2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Total Weight is 1300 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loader_(equipment).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。理论输送量是6–12 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loader_(equipment)。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loader_(equipment). The picture shows Loader (equipment). Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. The frame “Excavator” shows Excavator with grapple and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loader_(equipment)。画面是Loader (equipment)。河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Total Weight is 1300 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Subject: Excavator with grapple. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是6–12 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Total Weight is 1300 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Maximum aggregate size is 1–3 cm.
body.zh: 画面「Excavator」的主体是挖掘机 with grapple，不是这个型号的工地实测。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 6–12 m³/h. Total Weight 1300 kg.

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loader_(equipment).
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loader_(equipment)画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 6–12 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loader_(equipment).
